title: Fleet behavior and execution health (leader + member scorecard)
description: Per-fleet, per-window scorecard (24 criteria, healthy/degraded/broken/unknown) in three role scopes: [fleet] outcome (burn-down, shipping), [leader] conduct (continuity, rulings, dispatch verification, supervision economy, charter, churn, capacity, liveness, routing, backlog) and [member] conduct (claims/locks, report integrity, fix quality, responsiveness, lane restraint, filing, comms, context budget).
